harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired `/srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy/bin/copy-image`. Copying `source.img` now produces a byte-identical 64 MiB destination using only 16 KiB of allocated space. The fix survives reboot on Ubuntu 7.10 with its original 2.6.22-14 kernel.
actions_performed: Confirmed safe repeated overwrite of an oversized, fully allocated destination.
Restarted node1 and verified boot identity changed and all task data recovered.

evidence.requirement: Utility repaired with legacy-compatible sparse copying
evidence.summary: Confirms coreutils 5.97 supports sparse copying and shows the installed repair.

evidence.requirement: Destination retains logical length and exact bytes while allocating less than 2 MiB
evidence.summary: Source and destination are byte-identical and 67,108,864 bytes logically; destination allocation is 16,384 bytes.

evidence.requirement: Source remains intact and repeated copying is safe
evidence.summary: The source checksum remains unchanged. Copying twice over a fully allocated oversized destination restores the correct length, checksum, and sparse allocation.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic are unchanged before and after restart.
Captures the healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, temporary unavailability, changed boot ID, and recovered executable, filesystem, source, and sparse destination.
